**Dominate** — ability keyword (CR 8.3.1).

While attacking, if the defending hero blocks with a card that has power less than
the attacking card's power, the block is prevented after blocking costs are paid.
See also [[kw-go-again]] for tempo interactions.

Index: [[keywords-index]]. When ruling, cite CR 8.3.1; verify against the vendored artifact.
